title: Linearity of the vector Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f,g$ be real-valued functions on the binary cube, and let $\gamma$ be a binary-cube vector. The vector Fourier coefficient of $f-g$ at $\gamma$ equals the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\gamma$ minus that of $g$ at $\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ are real-valued functions on the binary cube
